correctness.rationale: The proof reduces all unital maps to three independent cube-zero images, treats characteristic three by Frobenius and ranks of 3-by-3 matrices, proves axis rigidity for each nonzero cotangent image when characteristic differs from three, reduces zero-cotangent cubicity to one degree-six coefficient, evaluates its six-variable zero count by a nondegenerate binary quadratic of discriminant square class 6, and applies inclusion-exclusion to all cotangent-rank strata. The extracted stand-alone checker exhaustively verifies degree-two counts for six fields and directly cubes 950 seeded full-ring elements. Tests support but do not substitute for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The endomorphism monoid and its cotangent-rank spectrum are canonical invariants of a natural 27-dimensional local monomial complete intersection. Three generators are the first box-cubic regime with a nontrivial cube of a quadratic radical element, producing the finite-field quadratic-character correction. Counts of all singular endomorphisms and the sharp characteristic-three transition provide information unobtainable from previously published automorphism-only counts; the exact narrow census is intrinsically motivated even without a broader downstream theorem.
